text:
Tess Morgan: flagging an oddity in the weekly KPI deck prep  webinar bench narrative looks strong for sessions but qualified leads routed to AE queue are down 50% after the launch. need a quick triage before we lock slides. https://redwood.app/dashboards/webinar-funnel :eyes:
salesops-bot: ALERT: lead routing rule 'auto-route-webinar' changed on 2026-08-03 by Samir Patel. 5k leads reclassified to 'nurture' queue. Details: https://redwood.app/audit/routing/778
Ethan Liu: wait that routing change was meant for a small geo test? Samir, did the rule include global scope accidentally?
Samir Patel: ugh yes  I updated rule to exclude EU but forgot to set condition on campaign_id. it matched any campaign with tag 'webinar'. rolling back now.
Priya Desai: quick numbers: raw webinar signups up 40% this week but AE-accepted MQLs down 48%. funnel looks like signup -> nurture tag -> no AE assignment.
Ethan Liu: can someone run a query to show routing assignment counts by tag? I want per-day breakdown 8/1-8/07.
Priya Desai: ran quick SQL on marketing.leads_routed:
```
SELECT date(created_at) as day, routing_queue, count(*) as cnt
FROM marketing.leads_routed
WHERE campaign = 'webinar-aug-2026'
AND created_at >= '2026-08-01'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1;
```
Result: 2026-08-03 -> nurture 842, AE-queue 112; previous days AE-queue ~600/day.
Samir Patel: rollback pushed. I also patched the rule to include `campaign_id = 'webinar-aug-2026'` and `region != 'EU-test'`. pushing and will monitor.
Ethan Liu: thanks. two separate things to reconcile for the deck: 1) the lead counts that fed the KPI snapshot (which used the routed AE queue count) and 2) attribution tiers. if leads were routed to nurture they might still show as conversions but not in AE-accepted MQLs. we need both numbers.
Tess Morgan: agree. action plan: Priya to backfill routed assignments for 8/01-8/05 and regenerate AE-queue counts; Samir to confirm routing rule rollback + add a guard; Ethan to re-run KPI snapshot both for last_touch and multi_touch attribution and attach both slides; I'll hold the bench narrative until numbers reconcile.
Priya Desai: starting targeted backfill now. job id 3347. this will re-run routing classification for 2026-08-01 -> 2026-08-05. ETA ~1.5h.
Samir Patel: guard added: rule now has `scope: test_geos_only` and two-step deploy. also adding a quick smoke test to check output counts. PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/642
salesops-bot: BACKFILL job 3347 queued by Priya Desai (targets 2026-08-01 -> 2026-08-05). Status: queued.
Ethan Liu: while backfill runs, quick check on attribution  the KPI snapshot we generated uses last_touch by default. can you also run the snapshot with multi_touch and channel assists? lead source mix may shift the narrative.
Priya Desai: backfill started. I'll post the before/after counts when done. also exporting a CSV for AE-queue assignment map: https://redwood.app/files/routing-backfill-3347.csv
Samir Patel: monitoring logs show rollback applied at 2026-08-03T14:02Z. no further matches expected. Smoke test passed on staging.
Priya Desai: backfill complete. recovered 523 leads routed to AE-queue in the window. Adjusted AE-accepted MQLs +49% for the week. uploading CSV: https://redwood.app/files/routing-backfill-3347-results.csv
Ethan Liu: re-ran KPI snapshot. with last_touch the launch email share is 38% of conversions; with multi_touch-assisted view it drops to 17% and paid search shows higher assists. attaching both slide links to deck.
Tess Morgan: great  that changes the benchmark narrative. we'll present the reconciled AE-queue numbers and note that a routing rule regression temporarily masked conversion performance. add a short ops slide in appendix describing the rollback and guard.
Samir Patel: apologies for the churn. adding a checklist to routing rule PRs now: include test campaign, geo scoping, and smoke count assertion.
Priya Desai: one more ask: can Sales Ops requeue the recovered leads for AE outreach? I can tag them `recovery-aug03` so they can be prioritized.
salesops-bot: JOB: requeue request submitted for tag 'recovery-aug03' (count: 523). Owner: Samir Patel. Status: pending.
Ethan Liu: will update the KPI narrative and push final deck by EOD. Tess, let me know if you'd like me to soften the bench headline.
Tess Morgan: please soften and add a note: "Numbers updated post-data-recovery; performance consistent with benchmark after routing fix." Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
